content.bridge_context: Learning to measure the 'fence' around a shape (perimeter) and the 'carpet' inside it (area).

units.title: The Boundary (Perimeter)
units.explanation: Perimeter is the total length of the boundary of a closed figure.
units.dual_language_instruction: Walk around your desk. The total distance is the perimeter. / अपनी डेस्क के चारों ओर घूमें। कुल दूरी परिमाप है।

units.title: The Surface (Area)
units.explanation: Area is the amount of surface covered by a closed figure.
units.dual_language_instruction: Cover a book with square stickers. The number of stickers is the area. / एक किताब को वर्गाकार स्टिकर से ढक दें। स्टिकर की संख्या क्षेत्रफल है।
